event_id.description: Monotonic id per trace connection; the console dedupes and orders on it (the lab's own id, distinct from the MCP SSE event id).

trace_id.description: One trace id per user turn, propagated host → MCP → upstream (§8.7).

span_id.description: OpenTelemetry span id when emitted from a span (§4.1).

source.description: Emitting process; alexa-lab relays server-side spans it receives (§4.1, §8.7 propagation).

badge.description: Truthful mode label for the turn: LIVE | REPLAY | FIXTURE (§4.2, AC-14).

sse_event_id.description: SSE event id from the server stream; reconnects resume with Last-Event-ID [VERIFY R-SPEC-01].

frame.description: Raw JSON-RPC frame for the inspector drill-down (§11.2). The emitter is responsible for redacting secrets; heard text appears deliberately — the inspector is the product's transparency surface.
